provinces.name: Punjab
provinces.overview: Punjab ko Salt Range, paanch darya aur un par bane headworks se yaad karein. Jhelum aur Chenab Trimmu ke qareeb milte hain; Indus Punjab ke maghribi kinare se guzarta hai.

mountains.name: Salt Range
mountains.detail: Punjab ke Jhelum, Chakwal, Khushab aur Mianwali ilaqon ka pahari silsila. Rock salt aur Sakesar se is ko jor kar yaad karein.

mountains.name: Sakesar
mountains.detail: Khushab mein Salt Range ki sab se buland choti; sawal mein peak aur range ko alag pehchanein.

mountains.name: Pothohar Plateau
mountains.detail: Shumali Punjab ka plateau; Soan Valley ke asaar-e-qadeema ka sawal is ilaqe se jura hai. Plateau ko mountain peak na samjhein.

mountains.name: Sulaiman Range
mountains.detail: Maghribi Punjab ke Dera Ghazi Khan ki pahari foothills Sulaiman system se milti hain; silsila Balochistan tak bhi jata hai.
mountains.provinceNote: Shared mountain system: Punjab ki western foothills aur Balochistan dono se mutalliq hai; isay sirf Punjab ka na samjhein.

rivers.name: Indus River
rivers.detail: Pakistan ka sab se lamba darya; Punjab mein Attock, Kalabagh, Chashma aur Taunsa ke sawalon se jura hai.
rivers.provinceNote: Indus KP se Punjab aur phir Sindh jata hai; source aur samandar tak ka safar Punjab tak mahdood nahin.

rivers.name: Jhelum River
rivers.detail: Kashmir se Punjab aakar Rasul se guzarta hai aur Trimmu ke qareeb Chenab se milta hai.
rivers.provinceNote: Darya ka source aur Kashmir Valley Punjab se bahar hain; yahan Punjab wala course aur Trimmu confluence murad hai.

rivers.name: Chenab River
rivers.detail: Punjab mein Marala, Khanki, Qadirabad aur Trimmu Chenab ke aham headworks hain.

rivers.name: Ravi River
rivers.detail: Ravi Lahore ke shumali janib behta hai; Harappa purane course ke qareeb tha.

rivers.name: Sutlej River
rivers.detail: Tibet se shuru hone wala darya Punjab mein Sulemanki aur Islam headworks se guzarta hai.
rivers.provinceNote: Is ka source Pakistan se bahar hai; Beas darya khud Pakistan mein alag se dakhil nahin hota.

barrages.name: Chashma Barrage
barrages.detail: Mianwali District mein Indus par; Chashma-Jhelum Link Canal yahin se pani leta hai.

barrages.name: Taunsa Barrage
barrages.detail: Dera Ghazi Khan ilaqe mein Indus River par bana barrage; is ke baad pani Guddu ki taraf jata hai.

barrages.name: Trimmu Barrage
barrages.detail: Jhang mein Jhelum aur Chenab ke milne ki jagah ke bilkul neeche Chenab par hai.

barrages.name: Khanki Barrage
barrages.detail: Chenab par Wazirabad/Gujranwala ilaqe ka barrage; Lower Chenab Canal is se pani leti hai.

barrages.name: Sulemanki Headworks
barrages.detail: Punjab mein Sutlej par; Ravi aur Chenab ke barrages se isay mix na karein.

lakes.name: Kallar Kahar Lake
lakes.detail: Chakwal ke Salt Range mein Kallar Kahar ki namkeen jheel; Punjab ke lake-location sawalon ke liye yaad rakhein.

lakes.name: Uchhali Lake
lakes.detail: Khushab ki Soon Valley ki saline lake; Sakesar is ilaqe ka aham peak hai.

lakes.name: Khabeki Lake
lakes.detail: Khushab ki Soon Valley mein Khabeki village ke qareeb lake; Uchhali se alag jheel hai.

provinces.name: Sindh
provinces.overview: Sindh mein Indus ke teen aham barrages Guddu, Sukkur aur Kotri hain. Kirthar range maghrib mein hai, jabke Manchar aur Keenjhar alag qisam ki lakes hain.

mountains.name: Kirthar Range
mountains.detail: Sindh ke maghribi kinare par pahari silsila; Ranikot Fort isi range ke qareeb hai.
mountains.provinceNote: Kirthar Sindh-Balochistan border ke dono taraf se mutalliq hai; sirf ek province ki range nahin.

rivers.name: Indus River
rivers.detail: Sindh ka markazi darya: Guddu, Sukkur aur Kotri se guzarta hua delta ke raste Arabian Sea mein girta hai.
rivers.provinceNote: Indus Sindh se pehle KP aur Punjab se bhi guzarta hai.

rivers.name: Gaj River
rivers.detail: Kirthar ilaqe ka seasonal darya; Nai Gaj Dam ke sawal mein Dadu ke qareeb is ka Sindh section yaad rakhein.
rivers.provinceNote: Gaj ka catchment Balochistan ki pahari drainage se bhi jura hai; dam-site Sindh mein hai.

rivers.name: Hub River
rivers.detail: Hub Dam isi darya par hai; Karachi aur Lasbela ko is project se pani milta hai.
rivers.provinceNote: Sindh-Balochistan boundary system; river aur dam ko dono provinces ke saath parhein.

barrages.name: Guddu Barrage
barrages.detail: Kashmore ke qareeb Indus par Sindh ka upstream barrage; Sukkur se pehle aata hai.

barrages.name: Sukkur Barrage
barrages.detail: Indus par Lloyd Barrage bhi kehte hain; Nara Canal yahin se nikalti hai. Guddu se purana barrage hai.

barrages.name: Kotri Barrage
barrages.detail: Indus par Sindh ka downstream barrage; is ka tareekhi naam Ghulam Muhammad Barrage hai.

barrages.name: Hub Dam
barrages.detail: Hub River par inter-provincial dam; Sindh ke Karachi aur Balochistan ke Lasbela dono ko faida deta hai.
barrages.provinceNote: Sindh aur Balochistan ka shared project; dono sections mein jaan-boojh kar dikhaya gaya hai.

barrages.name: Nai Gaj Dam
barrages.detail: Sindh ke Dadu ilaqe mein Gaj River par dam project; sawal district aur province se mutalliq hai.

lakes.name: Manchar Lake
lakes.detail: Sindh mein Indus ke maghrib Jamshoro/Dadu ke ilaqe ki natural freshwater lake; size mausam ke saath badalta hai.

lakes.name: Keenjhar / Kalri Lake
lakes.detail: Thatta ke qareeb artificial freshwater reservoir; Karachi ko pani dene ke liye aham hai. Manchar se mukhtalif hai.

lakes.name: Haleji Lake
lakes.detail: Sindh ki artificial freshwater lake aur Ramsar wetland; waterbirds ki wajah se mashhoor hai.

provinces.name: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa
provinces.overview: KP mein Chitral ka Hindu Kush aur Tirich Mir, Kabul-Indus ka milap, aur Tarbela/Warsak/Gomal Zam dams key study links hain.

mountains.name: Hindu Kush
mountains.detail: Chitral ka bara pahari silsila; Tirich Mir is ki sab se buland choti hai.
mountains.provinceNote: Hindu Kush Pakistan ke bahar Afghanistan tak bhi phaila hua hai.

mountains.name: Tirich Mir
mountains.detail: Chitral mein Hindu Kush ki buland tareen choti; K2 ko Karakoram aur Tirich Mir ko Hindu Kush se jor kar yaad karein.

mountains.name: Malika Parbat
mountains.detail: Kaghan Valley mein Lake Saif-ul-Muluk ke upar nazar aane wali choti.

rivers.name: Indus River
rivers.detail: KP mein Tarbela Dam ke neeche Attock ke qareeb Kabul River Indus mein milta hai.
rivers.provinceNote: Indus KP ke baad Punjab aur Sindh se bhi guzarta hai.

rivers.name: Kabul River
rivers.detail: Afghanistan se KP mein aane wala darya; Warsak Dam is par hai aur Attock ke qareeb Indus mein milta hai.
rivers.provinceNote: Kabul River ka source Pakistan se bahar hai; yahan KP wala course murad hai.

rivers.name: Gomal River
rivers.detail: South Waziristan mein Gomal Zam Dam is darya par hai; Balochistan ka Zhob River is ka tributary hai.

rivers.name: Kunhar River
rivers.detail: Kaghan Valley aur Naran ke paas behta hai; Saif-ul-Muluk aur Kaghan ke location sawalon mein madadgar hai.

rivers.name: Swat River
rivers.detail: KP ki Swat Valley ka darya; Federal Flood Commission Chakdara aur Munda par is ki flood monitoring dikhata hai.

barrages.name: Tarbela Dam
barrages.detail: KP ke Haripur ilaqe mein Indus par earth-filled dam; Mangla ka darya Jhelum hai, Indus nahin.

barrages.name: Warsak Dam
barrages.detail: Peshawar ke qareeb Kabul River par dam aur hydropower project.

barrages.name: Gomal Zam Dam
barrages.detail: South Waziristan mein Gomal River par; district aur river dono alag sawal ban sakte hain.

barrages.name: Khanpur Dam
barrages.detail: KP ke Haripur District mein Haro River par; Rawalpindi/Islamabad ko pani supply se bhi jura hai.
barrages.provinceNote: Pani Punjab aur ICT tak jata hai, lekin dam-site KP mein hai.

lakes.name: Lake Saif-ul-Muluk
lakes.detail: Kaghan Valley mein Naran ke qareeb alpine lake; Malika Parbat ko is ke saath yaad karein.

lakes.name: Lulusar Lake
lakes.detail: Kaghan Valley ki lake; Saif-ul-Muluk se alag aur Naran ke upper valley route par hai.

lakes.name: Mahodand Lake
lakes.detail: Swat ke Kalam ke upar Mahodand Valley ki lake; Kaghan wali Saif-ul-Muluk se confuse na karein.

provinces.name: Balochistan
provinces.overview: Balochistan ko plateau aur Kirthar/Sulaiman/Sor ranges, Hingol-Zhob-Dasht-Porali rivers, aur Hub/Mirani dams ke saath revise karein.

mountains.name: Balochistan Plateau
mountains.detail: Balochistan ka zyada tar ilaqa buland, khurdura plateau hai; PPSC mein is ki aam elevation range ka sawal aya hai.

mountains.name: Sulaiman Range
mountains.detail: Balochistan ke mashriqi highlands ka pahari silsila; Takht-e-Sulaiman isi system se jura sawal hai.
mountains.provinceNote: Silsila Punjab aur KP ke western ilaqon tak bhi jata hai; Takht-e-Sulaiman peak ko province-exclusive na samjhein.

mountains.name: Kirthar Range
mountains.detail: Balochistan ke mashriqi hisse aur Sindh ki maghribi boundary se jura pahari silsila.
mountains.provinceNote: Shared Sindh-Balochistan boundary range; dono provinces mein dikhaya gaya hai.

mountains.name: Sor Range
mountains.detail: Quetta ke qareeb coalfield se jura pahari ilaqa; sawal Sor Range ki mineral association par aya hai.

rivers.name: Hingol River
rivers.detail: Balochistan ka lamba coastal darya; Hingol National Park ka naam bhi isi se jura hai.

rivers.name: Zhob River
rivers.detail: Shumali Balochistan ka darya jo Gomal River system ki taraf behta hai.

rivers.name: Dasht River
rivers.detail: Kech/Turbat ilaqe ka darya; Mirani Dam isi par bana hai.

rivers.name: Porali River
rivers.detail: Balochistan ka coastal drainage darya; Hingol aur Dasht se alag pehchanein.

rivers.name: Hub River
rivers.detail: Sindh-Balochistan boundary system ka darya; Hub Dam isi par hai.
rivers.provinceNote: Sindh aur Balochistan dono se jura hua; kisi ek province tak mahdood nahin.

barrages.name: Hub Dam
barrages.detail: Hub River par inter-provincial dam; Karachi aur Lasbela dono ko pani deta hai.
barrages.provinceNote: Shared Sindh-Balochistan project; Sindh section mein bhi maujood hai.

barrages.name: Mirani Dam
barrages.detail: Kech District mein Turbat ke maghrib Dasht River par bana dam.

barrages.name: Wali Tangi Dam
barrages.detail: Quetta ke mashriq mein Balochistan ka dam; PPSC ka direct province-location sawal hai.

lakes.name: Hanna Lake
lakes.detail: Quetta ke qareeb lake; sawal mein city Quetta poochi gayi hai.

lakes.name: Hamun-i-Mushkhel
lakes.detail: Balochistan ka bara salt lake/saltpan; barish aur khushki ke mutabiq pani ka phelao badalta hai.
